note: The Lean covers the shell insertion, the commutator in the null space, the all-degree quarter-turn commutation and `Corners.none` giving T=0. The last sentence, selecting a finite separating subfamily by reducing the common kernel, is not in `erasing`; it is `Work.A07.finite_rows`, a generic lemma used elsewhere.

apply Corners.none T H.alt
  intro a b u v hb; apply LinearMap.ext; intro p
  let k := Corners.quarter a b
  obtain ⟨p,rfl⟩ := ((gear F).act d k.ortho).surjective p
  rw [← show (gear F).act d k.ortho _=_ from (hi u v a b hb p)]
  refine complete_turn F ?_ a b hb p
  intro s p
  let f := address F d p
  have hg := address_in F d p
  have hS (n) (x : Points (n+1)) (hx : x∈ conf _) :
      ∃ χ V,Table.Window x χ ∧ Motion (x:=x 0) (l:=0) V (wheel G s) χ := by
    obtain ⟨χ,hχ⟩ := Work.A01.exists_window x hx; exact ⟨χ,_,hχ,rotational_motion hχ.1 hχ.2.1 hχ.2.2.1 s⟩
  have he := sub_eq_zero.mp (ghosts_out (Submodule.sub_mem _ (wheel_holds s (brand_fit F (T u v) f)) (brand_fit F (T u v) _))
    (commute_ghost hd (hw u v) (hp u v) hS f hg (wheel_holds _ hg)))
  apply address_inj F d
  change address F d (scopeRise F d s _)=address F d (T u v (scopeRise F d s p))
  rw [scopeRewrite,← brand_eval,← brand_eval,scopeRewrite]
  exact he

proof_context.conclusion: For every degree `d`, `complete_turn` (commutation with infinitesimal rotations gives commutation with quarter turns) plus `commute_ghost` (the angular-shell Ward argument, `ghosts_out`) and `Corners.none` give `T=0`.

lemma complete_turn {T : Module.End ℂ ((Model F).Field d)}
    (h : ∀ u p,(gear F).lie d u (T p)=T ((gear F).lie d u p))
    (i j : Axis) (he : i≠j) (p : (Model F).Field d) :
    (gear F).act d (Corners.quarter i j).ortho (T p) = T ((gear F).act d (Corners.quarter i j).ortho p) := by
  let u := Ortho.plane i j
  let f := fun s => (gear F).act d (oneParameter u s)
  let A t := f t (T p)
  let C t := T (f t p)
  let M := ((gear F).lie d u).toContinuousLinearMap
  let L := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap T).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hp (s) : HasDerivAt A (M (A s)) s := circle_ode F u _ _
  have ht (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt C (M (C s)) s := by
    change HasDerivAt C ((gear F).lie d u (T _)) s
    rw [h]; exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (circle_ode F u p s)
  rw [Corners.sendsTime i j he]
  exact congr_fun (ODE_solution_unique_univ (s := fun _ => Set.univ) (fun (_ : ℝ) => M.lipschitz.lipschitzOnWith)
    (fun t => ⟨hp t, mem_univ _⟩) (fun t => ⟨ht t,mem_univ _⟩) (show A 0=C 0 from by
      simp [A,C,f,Work.A13.oneParameter_zero,(gear_port F).fixes])) _

proof_context.conclusion: Commutation with the Lie action of every skew generator implies commutation with the quarter-turn action, by ODE uniqueness along `oneParameter`.

theorem commute_ghost {L : Engine G 0} {T : Module.End ℂ (WickPol G)} (hd : 4≤d) (H : silence G d T)
    (ht : ∀ a b, T (polStress G a b)=0)
    (HL : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Points (n+1)), x∈conf _ → ∃ χ v, Table.Window x χ ∧ Motion (x:=x 0) v L χ)
    (p : WickPol G) (hp : p∈shellSector G d) (he : rewired L p∈shellSector G d) :
    rewired L (T p) - T (rewired L p) ∈ ghost G d := by
  intro n q x hq hx
  classical
  obtain ⟨χ,v,w,Hv⟩ := HL n x hx
  let B (p : WickPol G) := Fin.cons (α:=fun _ : Fin (n+1) => WickPol G) p q
  let f (i : Fin (n+1)) := update (B p) i (T (B p i))
  let R (i) := stressRead x v (f i)
  have hh : exportFlux (fun a y => ∑ i, R i a y) χ=0 := by
    rw [flux_invariant χ _ 0]
    · simp [exportFlux]
    intro a y hy
    have hu := Work.A01.window_separated hx w hy
    unfold R stressRead; rw [Finset.sum_comm];
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum];
    suffices hr : (∑ i, bookend x y (f i) (polStress G a b))=0 by rw [hr, smul_zero]
    have hm (i : Fin (n+1)) : B p i ∈ shellSector G d := Fin.cases hp hq i
    have ha := H _ (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ => WickPol G) (polStress G a b) (B p)) (Points.cons y x)
      (fun i => Fin.cases (chain hd (stress_label G a b)) hm i) hu
    conv at ha => lhs; rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero, ht] at ha
    rw [show moment G (Points.cons y x) (update (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ => WickPol G) (polStress G a b) (B p)) 0 0)=0 from
      MultilinearMap.map_coord_zero _ 0 (Function.update_self _ _ _),zero_add] at ha; refine Eq.trans ?_ ha
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    rw [book_eval,Fin.cons_succ]; congr 1
    exact Fin.cons_update ..
  rw [flux_series w.1 w.2.1] at hh
  · simp_rw [R,moment_force hx w Hv,Finset.sum_neg_distrib,neg_eq_zero] at hh
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hh
    have ha := H (n+1) (B (rewired L p)) x (fun i => Fin.cases he hq i) hx
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at ha
    have hm (i : Fin n) : update (f i.succ) 0 (rewired L (f i.succ 0)) = update (B (rewired L p)) i.succ (T (B (rewired L p) i.succ)) := by
      ext1 b; unfold f B; simp only [Fin.cons_succ]; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) b <;> simp
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero _)),Fin.cons_zero,Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero _)),Fin.cons_zero]
      by_cases h : j=i <;> simp_all [Function.update]
    simp_rw [hm] at hh
    let F := ((moment G x).toLinearMap (B p) 0)
    have hg v : moment G x (B v) = F v := by unfold F; rw [MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply]; unfold B; rw [Fin.update_cons_zero]
    dsimp only [f,B] at hh ha
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero,Fin.update_cons_zero] at hh ha
    rw [show moment G x (Fin.cons (rewired L (T p)-T (rewired L p)) q)=_ from hg _, map_sub,sub_eq_zero,← hg,← hg];
    exact add_right_cancel (hh.trans ha.symm)
  intro i a y hy; exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun b _ => petal_cost hx w a b _ Hv.symm hy

proof_context.conclusion: For silent `T` vanishing on the stress, `rewired L (T p) - T (rewired L p)` lies in `ghost G d`.
